verses.english: The faculties of faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā satta phalā sattānisaṁsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
verses.english: Because of developing and cultivating these five faculties, seven fruits and benefits can be expected.
They attain enlightenment early on in this very life.

verses.pali: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṁ ārādheti, atha maraṇakāle aññaṁ ārādheti.
verses.english: If not, they attain enlightenment at the time of death.

verses.pali: No ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṁ ārādheti, no ce maraṇakāle aññaṁ ārādheti, atha pañcannaṁ orambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti,
verses.english: If not, with the ending of the five lower fetters, they’re extinguished between one life and the next …
they head upstream, going to the Akaniṭṭha realm.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ime satta phalā sattānisaṁsā pāṭikaṅkhā”ti.
verses.english: Because of developing and cultivating these five faculties, these seven fruits and benefits can be expected.”
